Because all ensemble axes vary jointly, differences among groups are descriptive and not one-factor causal effects. Points are the 80 model estimates; filled and open symbols distinguish PDH and Near-PDH fits. Nested 50%, 80% and 95% HDRs combine structural uncertainty with available joint Hessian uncertainty. The axes are $SB_{t}$/$SB_{F=0}t$ and $F_{t}$/$F_{MSY}t$ for Majuro, and $SB_{t}$/$SB_{MSY}t$ and $F_{t}$/$F_{MSY}t$ for Kobe. Colour shows year and the outlined point marks 2024. Medians and central 50%, 80% and 95% intervals use all 800 model--recruitment realisations; ten thin lines show individual projection realisations. Historical intervals show structural uncertainty; projections add recruitment variability without Hessian parameter draws. The 0.20 line in panel a is the stock-wide LRP.
